title: Learnability, Identifiability, and Monitor Placement in Quantum Network Tomography
summary: Reliable quantum communication requires accurate characterization of the quantum links. This paper studies Quantum Network Tomography (QNT) under limited monitoring resources, where unknown link parameters are inferred from path-based measurements performed at monitor nodes. We introduce a cyclic sequential QNT protocol (CSQP) for arbitrary network topologies and develop a fixed-point learnability framework with an explicit algorithm for estimating link-level Werner parameters.
